Before you picture it
in your family

Good questions.
Clear answers.

Current app availability
Who is TrustinJr for, and how does it work?
We’re building the first experience for ages 4–5: questions, prepared discoveries, illustrated stories and early math on Apple Watch, with a Parent Dock on iPhone. It is audio-first, not screen-free; pictures, text and touch are part of the experience. It is a learning tool with a friendly character, not a substitute for the people in a child’s life.
What is real in this demo?
The artwork, prepared discoveries, story and recorded Trustin narration come from the project. The browser interface and Parent Dock are illustrative adaptations. There is no live AI conversation, voice recording or real child account. Sample settings and activity are held in this page’s memory and clear on reload.
What can I decide as a parent?
The design puts family topic preferences and listening settings in your hands, in addition to essential child-safety protections. In this demo, changing Moon questions to “With a grown-up” replaces its prepared answer with an invitation to ask you. That demonstrates one boundary; it does not prove that every native-app safeguard works perfectly.
Can AI get something wrong?
Yes. AI can be inaccurate, and automated safeguards can miss things. No system can promise perfect filtering. Important, sensitive or confusing questions belong with a trusted grown-up. Our whitepaper separates the research that informs us from outcomes that still need testing.
Will my child see ads or pressure to keep playing?
No child-facing advertising, sponsored answers or purchase pressure is a core commitment. We also design for natural stopping points—not endless feeds, streak pressure or rewards for staying longer.
Can I download it? What does it cost?
TrustinJr is in development and testing. A public App Store release, launch date and pricing have not been announced here. The current beta uses an Apple Watch normally paired with an iPhone; Family Setup onboarding is not supported in that beta. Check the current availability note before buying a device. This website demo is free and needs no account.
